# awkno

> The man page for the Aither World — every brick, stack and law, offline.

The family is only useful if you can find it. Its registry lives in one yaml in one monorepo and the laws live in a public skills pack, so a stranger with a terminal and no browser can reach neither — which makes "what exists and what should this talk to" a question asked of a person instead of a tool.

## Install

```
pip install awkno
```

## In Claude Code

- skill: `/awkno`

## Use it in 30 seconds

Ask it what a brick does and get the answer with your network cable out.

## Composes with

- [awskills](https://aitherium.github.io/awskills/) — Portable agent skills — self-contained procedures an agent loads on demand.
- [awfind](https://aitherium.github.io/awfind/) — A portable search client — query, results, ranking.
- [awm](https://aitherium.github.io/awm/) — A portable, scoped agent memory.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awkno
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awkno/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/awkno/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awkno.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
